Select exact IC50 activity records for human Cytochrome P450 1A2. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to filter by target name. Left join docs on assays.doc_id to get PubMed ID or DOI. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical SMILES. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep all activity rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
